[page 1]
     Composite Valve and Pump Datasheet - Rev C


Synthetic supplier composite datasheet. Project aliases have been added in brackets.

1. Automated valve family

 Property                                Value
 Type                                      2/2-way solenoid/pneumatic discrete valve
 Command                              24 VDC / Boolean open command
 Fail action                                   Spring return CLOSED
 Nominal opening time                         0.7 s
 Nominal closing time                          0.5 s
 Leakage at closed                       <0.02% Kv
 Permitted medium                         Water / aqueous NaCl, 0-120 degC
 Modelica abstraction                          ValveDiscrete; no modulation

Project automated tags: V1, V3, V5, V6, V8, V9, V11, V12, V15, V18, V20, V22, V23, V24, V25. Valves not in
this list are manual/local isolation, drain or cooling-water valves unless a later approved ICD assigns them to
the controller.

2. Return pump family

 Property                         P1                                 P2
 Service                                Concentrate return                        Condensate return
 Nominal mass flow                       0.30 kg/s                                    0.30 kg/s
 Nominal differential pressure              1.8 bar                                       1.8 bar
 Minimum source level permissive         LIS-701 >0.02 m                            LIS-601 >0.02 m
 Low discharge pressure alarm            PIS-901 <0.8 bar                          PIS-1001 <0.8 bar
 Dry-run policy                                   Inhibit start / trip                                     Inhibit start / trip

3. Installation note
Pump discharge headers are cross-connected to the charging-vessel return manifolds. Final routing is
determined by the approved process-routing change record, not by pump physical location alone.
